DEPARTMENT OF COMMUNITY EDUCATION AND DISABILITY STUDIES
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH -160014 (INDIA)
REVISED ADVERTISEMENT NOTICE
Applications are invited for the position of Two Guest Faculties (full time) in the Department
of Community Education and Disability Studies, Panjab University, Chandigarh to be filled for
the academic session 2024-25.
No. of Post: 02 (Two)
Sr.
No.

teaching Social Science/

Education or Education
with research emphasis
on Special Education
The above assignment is on lecture basis with a token honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per lecture
with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month (as per Panjab University Rules). The candidate
shall have to undertake that He/ She will not draw any fellowship/stipend or any financial
assistance from any agency during the period of teaching assignment at the Department of
Community Education and Disability Studies, P.U. Chandigarh.
The applications must duly filled hard copy of the application form and template pages 1 to 11
http://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf be submitted
by December 12, 2024 upto 05.00 p.m. in the office of Department of Community Education
& Disability Studies, Panjab University Chandigarh. Late applications will not be considered
and will stand rejected. After scruiting of the eligible candidates, list of shortlisted candidates
for the interview will be displayed on the department’s website.
Note:-No individual intimation will be sent. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the
interviews.
Sd/-
Dr. Saifur Rahman
Chairperson
